source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Χαρίσιος, Νικηφόρος και Αγάπιος»

attestations.note: The three are named on one page which then says «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο των Αγίων» — we have no details of the saints' lives. Because the line enumerates all three by name, each is kept as a folder of his own. The same Greek day keeps the venerable Agapius of the skete of Colciu, who has a page and a life of his own and is a different man; this one is a martyr of whom nothing at all is told. The etymology block over the name adds «Αθηναίος πολυμαθής φιλόσοφος», an Athenian polymath philosopher, which is a note on other bearers of the word and not a statement about this martyr.
